name: Cape Coral

neighborhoods.name: Cape Harbour
neighborhoods.homes: condos and townhomes near the marina

housing: Cape Coral's rentals are mostly single-family houses, many on canals with pools, lanais and boat docks, plus duplexes and some condos.
climate: Photograph the roof, lanai screens, pool equipment and any storm repairs, and test the air conditioning; hurricanes and humidity are the main risks.
fact: Cape Coral has more than 400 miles of canals, so many rental houses come with a dock and waterfront.
